events.title: Oasis's 'Definitely Maybe' Anniversary
events.blurb: Celebrate 32 years since Oasis dropped their debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Britpop Classic
angles.copy: 32 years ago, Oasis released 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the game. What's your favourite track from this Britpop masterpiece?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: Marking 57 years since the iconic Woodstock Music and Art Fair took place from August 15 to 18, 1969.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: 57 years since half a million gathered for three days of peace and music at Woodstock. Which legendary performance do you wish you'd seen live?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, 49 years after his passing.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: 49 years on, the music and legacy of Elvis Presley continue to thrill. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: 30 years since the hip-hop legend Tupac Shakur's tragic death.

angles.name: Hip-Hop Icon
angles.copy: 30 years since we lost a true icon. Tupac's influence on music and culture remains undeniable. What's his most impactful song for you?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: 56 years since the passing of guitar icon Jimi Hendrix on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: 56 years ago, the world lost a musical visionary. Jimi Hendrix's guitar work remains unmatched. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: Marking 57 years since The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on September 26, 1969, in the UK and October 1, 1969, in the US.

angles.name: Iconic Crossing
angles.copy: 57 years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That album cover, those tracks... pure genius. What's your stand-out moment from the record?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude have defined generations. What's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger and the tunes. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: 51 years since John Lennon released his timeless anthem 'Imagine' on October 11, 1971.

angles.name: A World of Peace
angles.copy: 51 years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine', a song that still inspires hope for a better world. What does this iconic track mean to you?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: 25 years ago, Apple unveiled the revolutionary first iPod, changing how we listen to music forever.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Music
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago, it put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changed the game. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating the iconic 007 franchise on James Bond Day.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite element of the 007 universe?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Imagine His Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring genius of John Lennon. His music continues to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy legend John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic brilliance is unmatched. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: Marking 58 years since The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Eclectic Masterpiece
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unveiled their ambitious 'White Album'. A sprawling, diverse collection that broke all the rules. Which track is your hidden gem?
